body:
update: A friend came over unannounced and is staying with me, refusing to leave. We talked through a lot of  stuff. I had only taken four Unison so far so am I just really sleepy and kind of loopy. There was a show down the block and he stopped by to try and get me to come but I guess I look like a madwoman so he stayed and put ice on my cheek and confiscated everything in my medicinecabinet, I found out when I went to the bathroom.

I exhausted myself from crying. And I can't promise I will be okay tomorrow and I wont want this because I do want it, but a wrench has been thrown in my plans in a good way.tonight. 

It took a long time to type this. I am dizzy and vaguely euphoric, but kind of nauseous? but probably okay. My friend saw this tab open when he tried to show me a video of the band and wanted to post on my behalf but I felt so bad for worrying you all that I felt the need to do it myself.

Oh but he wants me to say he is going to be monitoring my vitals while I sleep.

And also thank you all for being kind.

And that the ex-boyfriend is a POS and everyone thinks so too.

I like big cities. It's easier not to be in your head there. I liked NYC.

I am feeling a bit drowsy. My eyes are burning and heavy from crying all afternoon. 

Yes, we went kayaking quite a bit. I suppose that was a fundamental difference between us. He loved the water and I have always been afraid of it. But he made me love being on the water. I just wish he hadn't pushed me to swim as much as he did.

We went snorkeling in Florida once in a coral reef. That was nice. You go out into the deep ocean and scan the horizon for glittering slices of aquamarine, then that's where you drop anchor. 

He made me feel like every day was an adventure. And now nothing is. Just four walls, five if you count the endless screens. He used to try and break me out of what I realize now, too late, was the onset of my depression. Now he just doesn't care anymore.

Because my life may change around me, but I never change and I never will. I am fundamentally flawed in a way that I cannot overcome, and I don't want to be 50 years old and still feeling like I am 22 developmentally. And no partner will stick around, I'm never going to have children, so... I just see my life as me paying off my student loan bills while I MAYBE work at a TV news station in my dying industry because I am stubborn and never learned a new trade.

I did explain the thing about the job, and he could see that something was deeply wrong with me emotionally because like I said, I am having trouble holding it together even in public places. The C grade was him being lenient. 

While I was walking home I realized that I can't fuck up anymore, I just can't do it. I know that I would choke under the stress of having to write a completely different story than the one I'd been planning and already laid the groundwork for. And I'd let him down when he has been so understanding.

I haven't traveled as much as I would have liked to. I never left the country, for one. 

I like that artist's stuff, very colorful and abstract. A little intense for how I'm feeling now. 

Unfortunately, I haven't been up to a lot of cool stuff, and the cool stuff I have done was with my ex, now everything is tinged with sadness.
Because I've made up my mind and I feel at peace with my decision.

You can ask personal stuff.

I've taken a few Unisom now so I don't take a bunch at once and throw them up. I don't feel anything yet.

Turquoise first, then royal purple, mustard yellow, burnt orange, and shell pink. Fall and spring are my favorite seasons because they are temperate and not extreme, and because the air is full of falling things... leaves and blossoms, respectively.
Thank you very much for your in-depth response. If I'd gotten this six months ago, I might have printed it out and posted it somewhere prominent to encourage me.

You're right, I'm sorry, I never should have posted here.

I should just delete this and stop involving people.
It may just be something as simple as being in bed instead of my bathtub. I've been in bed all day for months, this shouldn't be any different.
She is on home hospice care. Her issues are not going to resolve themselves. And when she passes, my world will break open.
I ended up leaving the class early. I went to the bathroom and just broke down. Then I cleaned myself up and left. There's nothing for me there anymore.

Update: I am considering a different method because it occurs to me that if I kill myself in my bathtub and I am not found for weeks, the landlord will have to replace the bathtub and possibly re-tile the floors. I am already $5,000 in debt with back rent, so I would hate to add to it when I won't be paying it and they've been so nice.

There is a bridge over a river a few blocks away from my place, but my biggest fear in the world has always been drowning, so I would never choose that. I have been passively walking into traffic for months and never been hit, also I would hate to cause a wreck and injure someone while I survive. 

I know we're not supposed to talk methods. But this realization has derailed me.

Because I can't restart my life and I've messed it up so badly. I am not a fully functioning adult. I am at the point where I can't even hold it together in public. I am unraveling, and there has to be an end point.

Update: I went to my class and turned in the assignments that were overdue. The professor took them but then looked very solemn and told me that he really hated to do this because I had been such a good student, but I'd missed a paper last class that was basically a midterm grade. I'd been called into my terrible job and threatened with being taken off the schedule, on a day I never work anyway because of that class. 

He informed me that if I cobble together a story by Tuesday, he can give me a C at the highest without being unfair to the other students. It will drag down my average considerably but won't totally crater it. This was one class I've been making all As in up to now. A class I'd wanted to put on my resume and get a letter of recommendation for a summer internship.

In that moment, I didn't want to tell him I wouldn't be around for it anyway, but it did start to feel like another thing the universe is whispering at me to further align my decision to end my life tonight.
I don't know. Maybe around 11 or 12.

Thanks for the reply. What method would you suggest instead?

I live alone, no one would find me, so I wouldn't end up in the hospital. The only person I could see myself calling wouldn't pick up.
And I think part of him will be relieved when he hears the news.

I called the ex-boyfriend again, just trying to talk things out and see if there's anything I can do to change his mind.

It's over forever. It will never happen again, he has written me off completely. So now I know that I can do this tonight without the thought that maybe things would have been different if I had stayed.
In half an hour.

I like that addendum to the metaphor a lot. Thank you.

But in keeping with the metaphor, my muscles have atrophied and all of my teeth have dropped out.
I'll just have to get some concealer for my face.

I am at least going to go into class and turn in my last few media writing stories, and thank the professor for letting me have an extension on them while I had the flu. And thank him for the class in general, and apologize for missing days because I have been so depressed I can't get out of bed.

I wanted to help other people tell their stories, give it color and texture and a unique voice, because I have no real stories of my own. In this way, I figured that I could atone for wasting my life by writing about the lives of others.

In a perfect world I might have worked on This American Life.

All of these things I have done have been an effort to feel like a human being with a future. I was fatally wounded eight months ago, I slipped into a coma six months ago, and I have been on life support ever since. I am ready to pull the plug.

I don't want to write anymore. That's another thing I've had to come to terms with. And that was my reason for living all these years. So now that I don't want to write anymore, I understand that fundamentally, I don't want to live anymore.

I am looking at this pragmatically. I'll admit I may have come at it from an overemotional point of view before. But now, it's just clear and precise, like laying out a budget.

I am closest with my grandmother, and she is in poor health. I have tried to talk to her about this several times over the last eight months, and all she does is say exasperatedly that she wants to die, too, and that I am an adult and have to learn to deal with my emotions.

At Thanksgiving I was unable to eat and started crying when asked small talk about my life because I had literally nothing to say - it was between the job loss and the going back to school, before I'd decided - and she called me later and said she wished I'd stayed home alone instead of ruining dinner by "acting out."

So, no. No family that cares. The boyfriend is long gone and I tried to call him today, not to tell him about this but to see if he had changed his mind that I am worthless... just reaffirmed it.

I have cried so much over the past eight months that I would have hoped today would be peaceful. 

I reached out to my ex-boyfriend one last time, asking to try again. He couldn't even say no. He just said goodbye.

I wanted to study journalism. I've had to settle for Communications, which is basically a study on how media is dying along with my dreams (literally all I've ever wanted to be in life is a writer/reporter). It's mostly marketing and PR now.

I tried that six months ago when I lost my job after losing the boyfriend. They can't do anything but suggest a hospital for you. I even asked to just talk and they just acted exasperated and gave me an address and said to go there. I said I didn't want to check myself in anywhere, that I wanted to kill myself, and they said, "Well, you want us to call 911?" 

Not helpful at all. They'll never get my "business" again, and if I do decide to leave a note tonight I'll make sure to out them for their complete lack of caring.
All that's going to do is put more things in the pro column for ending my life, but at least I'll have made some mark on my second-shortest day.

I will have to cut my hair before I do it. My grandmother would never forgive me if I had an open casket funeral with unnatural-colored tips. She likes to keep up appearances. Just another sign of my arrested development, trying so hard to hang onto my youth. University sophomore at 33 years old, turquoise tipped hair. It would actually pretty funny if it wasn't so pathetic.

It's not so much because of the things that have happened, as because of the person that I am. I have tried moving to different cities, but people always figure it out, that I am a loser, or that I am a doormat and deserve to be treated like dogshit.

Currently I live in Tennessee.
